summary: Social worker and multicultural victim advocate with more than five years of experience in case management, crisis intervention and court accompaniment for survivors of domestic violence, human trafficking and related harms. Works with Latino and immigrant clients from varied ethnic and socio-economic backgrounds, providing safety planning, victim compensation navigation, referrals and legal-system guidance. Bilingual in Spanish and English with court interpretation and translation experience, and has trained professionals and facilitated community support groups. Brings strong interpersonal, records-management and strategic planning skills and is seeking a people-focused HR generalist role.
